newsitem.title: USA: Minor leak cuts Ashland's Minnesota plant output.
newsitem.headline: Minor leak cuts Ashland's Minnesota plant output.

text.p: Ashland Inc said Thursday it has cut production at its 69,000-barrel-per-day St Paul Park, Minnesota, plant following a minor leak in one of its crude heater units.
"One of our crude heater units is down and we are anticipating it to come back on line within the next 24-hours," said spokesman Stan Lampe.
Lampe would not say by how much production has been cut, but said it is minor. The leak, which Lampe also described as minor, was discovered Wednesday.
((-- Laney Salisbury, New York Oil Desk 1212 859-1631))
